solution: Rolled orders-api back to 5.1, then redeployed 5.2 later the same day with the new config map mounted.
short_description: orders api crash loop after deploy with missing config
trigger: orders-api 5.2 was deployed with a config map that no longer had PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL
problem_statement: orders-api 5.2 was deployed with a config map that no longer had PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL. The app exits on start when that variable is missing, so every pod crash looped and no orders could be placed for 17 minutes.
impact_description: Full outage of order creation for 17 minutes. About 2,300 checkout attempts failed. The monthly availability target of 99.9% was missed.
immediate_resolution: Ran kubectl -n shop rollout undo deploy/orders-api.

timeline.action: On-call followed SOP-DEPLOY-001 and rolled back.

timeline.event: The release owner, not knowing about the rollback, retried the 5.2 deploy. Pods crash looped again.
On-call read the logs and found "config error: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL is not set".
timeline.action: Told the release owner to stop deploys.

timeline.event: Rollout history showed the variable was dropped in the new revision.
timeline.action: Confirmed the cause with the release owner.
Ran kubectl -n shop rollout undo deploy/orders-api.

timeline.event: Pods running and orders flowing again.
timeline.action: Closed the incident. 5.2 was redeployed at 19:30 with the config map mounted.

root_causes: The deploy did not mount the new config map, so PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL was missing and the app exited on start.
Neither CI nor the readiness probe checked for required config, so the bad revision reached every pod.

action_items.action: Write SOP-DEPLOY-002 that reads the start up error before rolling back.
Fail CI when a required config key is missing.
Load config before the readiness probe reports ready.
Post every rollback in the deploy channel.
